fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local commentary on Greater Miami and Miami Beach, including criticism of delays repairing the Baker's Haulover bridge approaches after the 1926 hurricane, discussion of automobile license plate distribution, reports on destruction of unfit canned goods and health inspections, and calls for scrutiny of police practices. Includes letters to the editor about Florida Power & Light deposit requirements and employment agency fees, notes on civic matters (harbor cleanup, the Rose Mahoney wreck), and extensive holiday-related advertising and society/column items.
